title: tt-erf-fp32: FP32 erf for the Tenstorrent SFPU, at most 1 ULP on every input
description: FP32 erf for the Tenstorrent SFPU (Blackhole, Wormhole): a kernel within 1 ULP on every input and a faster variant, both checked on every positive FP32 input with a bit-exact model of the hardware arithmetic. Proposed upstream in tenstorrent/tt-metal pull request 66809.
